      • DBInstanceId

        @NameInMap(value="DBInstanceId")
public String DBInstanceId

        The instance ID.

        This parameter is required.

        example:

        rm-t4n8t18o******6d5

      • encryptionAlgorithm

        @NameInMap(value="EncryptionAlgorithm")
public String encryptionAlgorithm

        The encryption algorithm. Valid values:

        • AES_128_CBC
        • AES_128_GCM
        • AES_128_CTR
        • AES_128_ECB
        • AES_256_CBC
        • AES_256_GCM
        • AES_256_CTR
        • AES_256_ECB
        • SM4_128_CBC
        • SM4_128_GCM
        • SM4_128_CTR
        • SM4_128_ECB
        example:

        AES_256_GCM

      • encryptionKey

        @NameInMap(value="EncryptionKey")
public String encryptionKey

        The ID of the encryption key. This parameter is required when you use a KMS key.

        example:

        749c1df7----

      • encryptionKeyMode

        @NameInMap(value="EncryptionKeyMode")
public String encryptionKeyMode

        The column encryption key mode. Valid values:

        • client_key: A user-generated random key configured on the client side.
        • kms_key: A custom key configured by using Alibaba Cloud KMS.

        Note After an instance is configured to use a KMS key, you can no longer use a random key configured on the client side.

        example:

        kms_key

      • encryptionStatus

        @NameInMap(value="EncryptionStatus")
public String encryptionStatus

        The column encryption status. Valid values:

        • 1: Encryption is enabled.
        • 0: Encryption is disabled.

        This parameter is required.

        example:

        1

      • isRotate

        @NameInMap(value="IsRotate")
public Boolean isRotate

        Specifies whether to rotate the key.

        example:

        true

      • roleArn

        @NameInMap(value="RoleArn")
public String roleArn

        The global resource descriptor of the role, used to specify the specific role. For details, see RAM role overview. Note This parameter takes effect only when the column encryption key pattern is set to kms_key. If you do not specify this parameter, the internal default value is used.

        example:

        acs:ram::1406926****:role/aliyunrdsinstanceencryptiondefaultrole

      • whiteListMode

        @NameInMap(value="WhiteListMode")
public Boolean whiteListMode

        Specifies whether to enable the whitelist mode. A value of true indicates that only columns in the whitelist are encrypted. A value of false indicates that all columns are encrypted.

        example:

        true
